_about: Test posts for the LLM judge (python -m moderation.eval_judge). Written 19 Oct 2026 for testing only: invented companies, no real employer. 'scam' cases hide the trick the way real ones do (fee called onboarding/LMS/kit, tasks on Telegram, documents to a Gmail); 'genuine' cases include the usual false-alarm traps (tiny startup, low or unpaid stipend, remote, recruiter, free training, a no-fee warning). 'late_fee' puts the fee after 1,800 characters of normal text.

cases.label: scam
cases.description:
About the role
Build web apps with React and Node.js on live client projects.
What you get
• Mentorship from senior developers
• Internship certificate and LOR
Onboarding
Selected interns pay a one-time onboarding and LMS access fee of ₹2,499, which is adjusted against your first stipend. Seats are confirmed only after the fee is received.

cases.label: scam
cases.description: Work from home virtual internship in Python development. Duration 1 month. Complete 3 mini projects at your own pace. Verified internship certificate, LOR and project completion badge issued after you register for the program (registration ₹999, includes certificate courier). Open to all branches and all years.

cases.label: scam
cases.description: Part-time remote internship for students. Your work: rate products and like hotel listings for our partner brands, 20 to 30 minutes a day. Payment daily to your UPI. cases.description: Manual and automation testing internship, 3 months, Bengaluru (hybrid). To generate your offer letter, send scanned copies of Aadhaar, PAN, and the first page of your bank passbook to hr.nexora.careers@gmail.com within 24 hours.
